## Type of change

- [ ] feat (new feature / minor version bump on release)
- [ ] fix (bug fix / patch version bump on release)
- [ ] docs
- [ ] refactor / style (no behavior change)
- [ ] test
- [ ] chore (build, tooling, CI)

## Checklist

- [ ] Code follows the project's ESLint/Prettier rules (`npm run lint` passes)
- [ ] Tests added/updated for the change (`npm test` passes)
- [ ] CLI behavior changed → `npm run test:src` passes
- [ ] User-facing change → README option table / `docs/` updated
- [ ] No hand-edit of `package.json` version or `CHANGELOG.md`
